lines.2: I was aiming for an infield hit.
lines.3: I took a sharp swing at the first pitch.
lines.6: Murata leaped and got his glove on the liner at second.
lines.7: But the force of the ball knocked it out of his glove.
lines.10: Sunao secured the loose ball before it could touch the ground.
lines.13: 「Hmph. I'm not letting YOU reach base.」
lines.14: She really did hate me, didn't she...?
